Every assessment uses the same library, AI controls, reports and integrations
Engineering and business tasks run on the same scoring engine
Choose from 1,300+ validated engineering tasks across 80+ languages and frameworks, or business tasks to complete with the AI Assistant. The library is available across the entire platform.
Allow AI or turn it off. Review every prompt.
Allow the AI Assistant or turn it off for each task. Every prompt is saved for review, alongside identity, behavioral and similarity signals, including hidden apps. People review the evidence, and nothing rejects a candidate automatically.
See the work behind each result
Review results, submitted work and activity in one report. See the evidence behind each result before making a hiring or development decision.
Connect to your existing systems
Send screening results to your ATS. Import employee data into Skills Intelligence from your HR system. All products share single sign-on, EU or US hosting, SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001.
See every integration
Use one method and one report for every team
Standardize assessment across teams with shared methods and reporting. Our team of specialists can help you when you need advanced support with rollout design, mapping to your skills framework and local validation.
Explore the assessment methodology
Assessment science you can inspect
The only assessment platform that publishes its methodology: a Technical Manual, adverse impact monitoring at every measured cut score and an independent cApStAn linguistic audit.
